note: The build guide as data. docs/BUILD_GUIDE.md explains WHY; the four cards under docs/build/ are the working playbooks; this says where each rule bites and what enforces it. Each card carries a BUILD_RULES manifest naming the ids it covers, so a rule cannot be dropped by rewriting prose.

rules.statement: Start from the advocate's outcome, not from a screen, model or component.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Build a vertical, usable path. A correct component behind a broken served journey is not a delivered feature.
rules.why_not: nothing distinguishes a vertical path from a component

rules.statement: State the contract before writing code: what it does, never does, produces, refuses, recovers from and how it will be evaluated.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Protect emergency, conflict, competence, engagement, capacity, role, privilege and authority boundaries before substantive work.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Treat Take the Brief as an interactive, multimodal and retrieval-first loop, not a form and not a fixed questionnaire.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Keep fact, allegation, admission, source text, testimony, transcript, inference, assumption, law and professional judgment distinct.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Use deterministic rules for identity, dates, arithmetic, permissions, validity, state transitions and gates. Use models only for work that genuinely requires interpretation or judgment.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Make every material proposition traceable to its source, locator, status and current validity.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Never let absent, failed, stale, low-confidence or unassessed input look complete or successful.
Commit accepted state before emitting advice. The user must never receive a position the matter record does not hold.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Solve the general defect shape, sweep the whole population and prove the control with a counterexample.
Keep one owner for every fact. Generated views may explain the truth but may not become another place to maintain it.
Treat confidentiality, privilege, matter isolation, least privilege, retention and deletion as product behaviour, not deployment polish.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Make the interface calm, plain, respectful, accessible and truthful about work, delay, uncertainty and failure.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: A passing unit test is necessary and insufficient. Prove the served path, legal quality, professional quality and failure/recovery path.
rules.why_not: the served path is excluded from the per-task gate by design

rules.statement: A new feature must pass with all earlier verified behaviour in the same cumulative run.
rules.why_not: nothing runs earlier verified behaviour as one cumulative set

rules.statement: done is derived from current evidence. Nobody types it into a plan.
Only a current, cumulative release decision permits shipment. A later green gate never cancels an earlier failure, stale result or missing run.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: A registered item and one delivery wave own it.
rules.check: tools/backlog.py lint -- active item has no delivery wave

rules.statement: Dependencies are known and do not run backward.
rules.check: tools/backlog.py lint -- depends on a later wave

rules.statement: The user, role, commission and professional outcome are clear.
The journey step and feature are linked.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: DOES, NEVER, PRODUCES and EVAL are complete.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Entry, refusal, failure/recovery, exit and return transitions are stated.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: State, provenance, permissions and invalidation rules are defined.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Security, privacy, accessibility and operational impact are assessed.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Acceptance criteria are atomic.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Each required proof and counterexample is named.
rules.check: tools/backlog.py lint -- a P0 criterion with no negative control

rules.statement: Product or counsel decisions needed to implement are resolved.
The affected code and data population has been enumerated.
rules.why_not: nothing records that a population was enumerated

rules.statement: The complete vertical path is implemented, not only one layer.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Success, refusal/blocking and failure/recovery behaviour pass.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Retry, restart, replay, concurrency and cancellation pass where relevant.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: The invariant catches its named negative control.
Every required test exists, collects and is current.
rules.check: tools/backlog.py lint -- proof names a test that does not exist

rules.statement: Earlier verified behaviour passes in the same cumulative run.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: The served journey uses real preceding state and passes.
rules.why_not: the journey suite is in no gate and needs a browser

rules.statement: Legal/model evaluation passes when legal output can change.
Named counsel review passes every applicable professional standard.
Security, privacy, accessibility and performance evidence is current.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: The user-visible result and persisted record agree.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Status, evidence, next action and forensic record are reconciled.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Generated views are current and no second status truth was created.
Rollback, monitoring and evidence-invalidation paths exist where needed.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: No unresolved P0 or mandatory release gate affects the claim.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: the governing requirement or role decision is unresolved
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: the journey or feature contract is partial
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: the work has no registered item or wave
rules.check: tools/backlog.py lint -- row not in the registry, or no wave

rules.statement: a hard dependency is later than its consumer
rules.check: tools/backlog.py lint -- depends on a later wave

rules.statement: substantive work can cross an uncleared professional gate
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: provenance or authority would be lost
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: absent or failed assessment can read as success
the relevant population was not enumerated
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: a critical check has no demonstrated negative control
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: the served path or recovery path was not exercised
rules.why_not: the served path has no runner in the per-task gate

rules.statement: legal output changed without current real-model and counsel evidence
a required gate is FAIL, NOT RUN, STALE or BLOCKED
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: a P0 confidentiality, authority, grounding, persistence or legal-correctness risk remains open
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: rollback or truthful degraded behaviour is unavailable for a harmful failure
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: A horizontal component presented as a shipped user outcome.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: Code started against an incomplete contract.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: A model prompt carrying a deterministic safety rule by itself.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: A fixed intake questionnaire that ignores known or retrievable material.
Transcript, OCR or allegation promoted directly to fact.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: A generic issue list without threshold ordering or dependencies.
Advice whose maturity exceeds the brief and legal work.
A correct legal answer with no useful-remedy or enforceability analysis.
A recommendation treated as authority to act.
A successful return value with an uncommitted or failed matter record.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: A clean screen produced because the screen did not run.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: A one-site patch for a recurring defect shape.
A test that never demonstrates it can fail.
A browser-green journey used as evidence of legal quality.
A counsel-approved sample used as evidence of recovery or isolation.
A current-status count typed into prose or a workbook.
A missing or stale proof treated as good enough because the code is present.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work

rules.statement: A release exception without owner, compensation and expiry.
rules.why_not: no control proposed yet; mechanising it is open work
